graph_kind: static ETL dependency topology derived from accessible source artifacts; not a dbt manifest export
source_scope: one accessible backend repository; raw source identifiers redacted from exported graph

governance_field_semantics.has_steward: false means no steward signal was available in accessible source artifacts; not a catalog assertion
governance_field_semantics.has_tests: false means no dbt/data-quality test signal was available in accessible source artifacts; code unit tests were not counted as data-quality tests
governance_field_semantics.has_documentation: false means no catalog description was available in accessible source artifacts

known_limitations: No dbt manifest.json or catalog.json was reachable via the active connectors at export time.
The topology reflects static source-code lineage inference, not runtime execution lineage.
Governance attributes are observation-based placeholders because no catalog export was reachable.
